articles.title: We Asked Our Favorite Authors What to Read Before Summer Ends—Here’s What They Said
articles.content:
推荐人：泰勒里·琼斯（Tayari Jones），《亲属》（Kin）作者
类型：书信体小说
窥探他人通信的书籍总是令人难以抗拒，不是吗？如果你同意，那么《通讯员》（The Correspondent）就是为你准备的。这本书讲述的是73岁的西比尔·范·安特韦普（Sybil Van Antwerp），她通过写信与朋友、家人甚至著名作家交流，反思塑造她一生的爱情与秘密。随着视力的衰退，这些书信对她变得更加重要。这是一部温暖而亲密的读物，适合喜欢深入了解人物并逐渐揭开其成长之谜的读者。

推荐人：玛丽·H·K·崔（Mary H.K. Choi），《浴房》（Pool House）作者
类型：文学小说
一部消失的录音成为这本聪明又略显奇异的小说的核心。当一次采访失踪后，涉事人员必须凭借记忆重新构建对话，而他们的版本自然不尽相同。从这里开始，勒纳（Lerner）探讨了记忆、语言以及我们是否能真正捕捉他人含义的问题。这是一部适合喜欢略带智性的小说并享受章节结尾时有所思考的读者的作品。

推荐人：蒂娅·威廉姆斯（Tia Williams），《错失的联系》（The Missed Connection）作者
类型：心理恐怖
成为畅销书作者听起来很棒，直到你的粉丝绑架了你。这正是小说家保罗·谢尔登（Paul Sheldon）在车祸后受伤并住在安妮·威克斯（Annie Wilkes）家中康复时所经历的。安妮是一名前护士，对保罗的书痴迷不已。当她发现保罗杀死了她的心爱角色“痛苦”（Misery）时，她迫使保罗写一个新故事让痛苦复活。保罗被困，完全处于安妮的摆布之下。威廉姆斯对这部史蒂芬·金（Stephen King）的经典之作的评价是：“这本书养育了我。”

推荐人：伊萨克·菲茨杰拉德（Isaac Fitzgerald），《美国漫游者》（American Rambler）作者
类型：非小说
还记得《少女》（Girls）突然让莱娜·邓卜（Lena Dunham）成为流行文化中最受关注的人之一吗？《名利病》（Famesick）带你走进那个旋风般的时代，从与杰尼·康纳（Jenni Konner）共同制作HBO系列剧到应对名声、网络审查、人际关系、健康问题和职业倦怠。邓卜也坦诚地谈论了她与杰克·安东诺夫（Jack Antonoff）的关系以及经历公众生活的奇异体验。这本书适合喜欢揭露幕后故事但又希望有真诚而非明星光环的读者。

推荐人：崔
类型：反乌托邦小说
在1984年和《饥饿游戏》之前，有《我们》（We）。D-503生活在“一国”（One State），在那里人们有编号而非姓名，每一天的生活都被严格控制。然后他遇到了I-330，一个叛逆的女人，她喝酒，吸烟，对规则毫无兴趣。突然间，D-503开始质疑他曾经相信的一切。这本书适合喜欢反乌托邦世界、危险浪漫以及意识觉醒的主角的读者。

推荐人：杰尼·杰克逊（Jenny Jackson），《香波效应》（The Shampoo Effect）作者
类型：历史小说
亚瑟王、骑士与浪漫？详细说说。这部小说《崇拜》（Worship）讲述的是伊索德公主（Princess Isode），她原本要嫁给骑士帕洛米德（Palomides），直到西尔·特里斯坦（Sir Tristam）在一次比赛中击败了他，一切都改变了。特里斯坦志在加入亚瑟王的圆桌骑士团，但战争很快将他和伊索德推到了一起。充满危险、宫廷阴谋和浪漫张力。正如杰克逊所说：“这是关于圆桌骑士的故事，非常浪漫。”

推荐人：菲茨杰拉德
类型：科幻奇幻
“世界末日、外星游戏秀和会说话的猫”没有什么比这更舒适了。在《地牢冒险家卡尔》（Dungeon Crawler Carl）中，卡尔在世界末日后幸存下来，与他前女友的宠物波斯猫“甜甜圈公主”共同战斗，这只猫因吃了魔法饼干而变得聪明起来。他们的生存状况被广播到整个星系以供娱乐，因此每一次与怪物的战斗都伴随着观众。这本书既奇异又搞笑，菲茨杰拉德认为这是他目前的舒适读物之一。

推荐人：杰克逊
类型：文学与哲学小说
塔拉·塞尔特（Tara Selter）是一位罕见古籍商人，发现自己被困在11月18日重复的日子里。周围的人都进入下一天，但塔拉每天都醒在这一天。她可以旅行和改变事情，有些改变会保留下来。不久，她开始实验自己对这奇怪新生活有多少控制权。杰克逊称这本书为“由女性撰写的《陆地日》”，并认为它“超级深思”。她还将其比作加拿大小说家艾米莉·圣约翰·曼德尔（Emily St. John Mandel）作品中最好的部分，但“更紧凑、更小”。

推荐人：崔
类型：文学小说
与错误的人约会、处理家庭矛盾和做出可疑的生活选择都是洛里·摩尔（Lorrie Moore）的《自助》（Self-Help）的公平游戏。这部作品将自助书籍中熟悉的语言转化为关于女性处理婚外情、孤独和复杂关系的有趣故事。摩尔擅长将日常尴尬变得既搞笑又让人痛苦地熟悉。当你想要一些聪明且有趣的读物时，可以随时翻开其中一个故事。

推荐人：杰克逊
类型：悬疑小说
杰克和温在加拿大荒野准备进行一次平静的独木舟旅行。然而，他们看到了一场野火并听到了附近一对夫妇的争吵。他们看不到陌生人是谁或正在发生什么，但知道事情不对劲。随着火势逼近，朋友们必须决定是继续前进还是介入。杰克逊认为这部小说是一部“爆款”，适合喜欢美丽荒野背景、快节奏悬念和渐渐感到假日出行严重出问题的读者。

推荐人：崔
类型：历史小说
1865年的爱尔兰是这部关于家庭、土地和仍在从大饥荒中恢复的国家的宏大故事的背景。测量师托马斯（Tomás）带着他的儿子利亚姆（Liam）周游爱尔兰，为英国军械测量局绘制地图，同时遇到被饥荒掏空的村庄和被迫离开家园的家庭。与此同时，利亚姆在爱尔兰民间传说中成长，了解土地的故事。这是一部适合喜欢带有强烈地域感和以家庭故事为核心的历史小说的读者的作品。

推荐人：杰克逊
类型：科幻小说
凯西、露丝和汤米在英国寄宿学校海勒姆（Hailsham）一起长大，这所学校看起来是理想的，直到这三位朋友开始发现它与其他学校有何不同。随着年龄的增长，他们了解到被养育在这里的真相以及未来的前景后，感到震惊。他们的友谊和浪漫纠葛随着这一现实的深入而变得更加复杂。《永不放弃》（Never Let Me Go）适合喜欢带有毁灭性秘密核心的安静故事的读者。

获取《读者文摘》的“阅读升级”新闻通讯，了解更多书籍、访谈、有趣事实、幽默、清洁、旅行和科技的全周资讯。
在《读者文摘》中，我们已经分享了超过100年的最爱书籍。我们与畅销书作者如苏珊·奥利安（Susan Orlean）、珍妮特·埃文诺维奇（Janet Evanovich）和亚历克斯·黑莉（Alex Haley）合作过，后者的普利策奖获奖作品《根》是由本杂志资助并最初发表的项目。通过《小说精选》（Fiction Favorites，以前为《精选版》和《缩编书籍》），《读者文摘》出版了精编小说选集数十年，与包括詹姆斯·帕特森（James Patterson）、露丝·华尔（Ruth Ware）、克里斯汀·汉纳（Kristin Hannah）等众多大牌作者合作。由书籍编辑特蕾西·尼瑟科特（Tracey Neithercott）主持的《读者文摘书俱乐部》将读者引荐给更多当代最佳虚构作品，作者包括崭露头角、畅销及获奖作家。为了本文，莱·贝尔兹·雷（Leigh Belz Ray）采访了各位作者以进行《读者文摘》的电梯采访系列。我们核实所有事实和数据，用可信来源支持，并不时重新审视以确保其保持准确和最新。了解更多关于我们团队、我们的贡献者及我们的编辑政策。
articles.summary:
The Correspondent by Virginia Evans

Recommended by: Tayari Jones, author of Kin

Genre: Epistolary fiction

Books that let you peek into someone else’s correspondence are irresistible, aren’t they? If you agree, The Correspondent is for you. It follows 73-year-old Sybil Van Antwerp, who writes letters to friends, family and even famous writers as she reflects on the loves and secrets that have shaped her life. As her eyesight begins to fail, those letters become even more important. This is a warm, intimate read for anyone who loves getting deeply attached to a character and slowly discovering what made her who she is.

Shop Now

Transcription by Ben Lerner

Recommended by: Mary H.K. Choi, author of Pool House

Genre: Literary fiction

A missing recording is at the center of this clever, slightly strange novel. When an interview disappears, the people involved have to reconstruct what was said from memory, and naturally, their versions don’t quite match. From there, Lerner plays with memory, language and the question of whether we can ever truly capture what someone else meant. It’s a good choice for readers who like their fiction a little brainy and enjoy finishing a chapter with something to puzzle over.

Shop Now

Misery by Stephen King

Recommended by: Tia Williams, author of The Missed Connection

Genre: Psychological horror

Being a bestselling author sounds pretty great until your biggest fan kidnaps you. That’s exactly what happens to novelist Paul Sheldon after a car accident leaves him injured and recovering in the home of Annie Wilkes, a former nurse who is obsessed with his books. When Annie discovers he has killed off her beloved character Misery, she forces him to write a new story bringing her back. Paul is trapped and completely at her mercy. Williams’s note on this Stephen King classic? “This book raised me.”

Shop Now

Famesick by Lena Dunham

Recommended by: Isaac Fitzgerald, author of American Rambler 

Genre: Nonfiction

Remember when Girls suddenly made Lena Dunham one of the most talked-about people in pop culture? Famesick takes you behind that whirlwind, from making the HBO series with Jenni Konner to dealing with fame, internet scrutiny, relationships, health struggles and burnout. Dunham also gets candid about her relationship with Jack Antonoff and the strange experience of having so much of her life play out in public. It’s a great pick for anyone who loves a juicy behind-the-scenes story but wants more honesty than celebrity gloss.

Shop Now

We by Yevgeny Zamyatin

Recommended by: Choi

Genre: Dystopian fiction

Before 1984 and The Hunger Games, there was We. D-503 lives in the One State, where people have numbers instead of names and every part of the day is carefully controlled. Then he meets I-330, a rebellious woman who drinks, smokes and has zero interest in following the rules. Suddenly, D-503 starts questioning everything he once believed. This one is for anyone who loves a dystopian world, a dangerous romance and a protagonist who has a very inconvenient awakening.

Shop Now

Worship by Alice Winn

Recommended by: Jenny Jackson, author of The Shampoo Effect

Genre: Historical fiction

Camelot, knights and romance? Tell us more. Worship follows Princess Isode, who expects to marry the knight Palomides until Sir Tristam defeats him in a tournament and changes everything. Tristam has his sights set on joining King Arthur’s Round Table, but war soon throws him and Isode together. There’s danger, court intrigue and plenty of romantic tension. As Jackson puts it, “It’s all about knights at the Round Table, and it’s very romantic.”

Shop Now

Dungeon Crawler Carl by Matt Dinniman

Recommended by: Fitzgerald

Genre: Science-fiction fantasy

Nothing says cozy quite like an apocalypse, an alien game show and a talking cat. In Dungeon Crawler Carl, Carl survives the destruction of Earth and ends up battling through a deadly dungeon with Princess Donut, his ex-girlfriend’s pampered Persian cat who becomes intelligent after eating a magical biscuit. Their survival is broadcast across the galaxy for entertainment, so every monster fight comes with an audience. It’s wildly weird, genuinely funny and, according to Fitzgerald, one of his current comfort reads.

Shop Now

On the Calculation of Volume by Solvej Balle

Recommended by: Jackson

Genre: Literary and philosophical fiction

Tara Selter is a rare-book dealer who discovers she’s stuck on Nov. 18. Everyone around her moves on to the next day, but Tara keeps waking up on the same date. She can travel and make changes, though, and some of those changes stick. Soon, she’s experimenting with just how much control she has over her strange new existence. Jackson calls this book “Groundhog Day as written by a woman” and says it’s “super cerebral.” She also compares it to the best parts of Canadian novelist Emily St. John Mandel’s work, but “tighter and smaller.”

Shop Now

Self-Help by Lorrie Moore

Recommended by: Choi

Genre: Literary fiction

Dating the wrong person, navigating family drama and making questionable life choices are all fair game in Lorrie Moore’s Self-Help. The collection turns the familiar language of advice books into funny, sharp stories about women dealing with affairs, loneliness and complicated relationships. Moore has a knack for making everyday awkwardness feel hilarious and painfully familiar. Pick this up when you want something smart and funny that you can dip into one story at a time.

Shop Now

The River by Peter Heller

Recommended by: Jackson

Genre: Thriller

Jack and Wynn head into the Canadian wilderness expecting a peaceful canoe trip. Instead, they spot a wildfire and hear a couple arguing somewhere nearby. They can’t see who the strangers are or what’s happening, but they know something is wrong. As the fire moves closer, the friends have to decide whether to keep going or get involved. Jackson considers this novel a “banger,” and it’s an easy pick for anyone who likes beautiful wilderness settings, fast-moving suspense and the creeping feeling that a relaxing vacation has gone very, very wrong.

Shop Now

Land by Maggie O’Farrell

Recommended by: Choi

Genre: Historical fiction

Ireland in 1865 is the setting for this sweeping story about family, land and a country still recovering from the Great Hunger. Surveyor Tomás travels through Ireland with his young son, Liam, mapping the landscape for the British Ordnance Survey while encountering villages emptied by famine and families forced from their homes. Meanwhile, Liam is growing up surrounded by Irish folklore and stories about the land. It’s a strong choice for anyone who wants historical fiction with a big sense of place and a family story at its center.

Shop Now

Never Let Me Go by Kazou Ishiguro

Recommended by: Jackson

Genre: Science fiction

Kathy, Ruth and Tommy grow up together at Hailsham, an English boarding school that seems idyllic until the three friends begin discovering what makes it so different from other schools. As they get older, they learn the disturbing truth about why they were raised there and what their futures hold. Their friendships and romantic entanglements become more complicated as that reality sinks in. Never Let Me Go is perfect for readers who love a quiet story with a devastating secret at its core.

Shop Now

The Reader’s Digest Book Club, helmed by Books Editor Tracey Neithercott, introduces readers to even more of today’s best fiction by upcoming, bestselling and award-winning authors. For this piece, Leigh Belz Ray interviewed various authors for The Reader’s Digest Escalator Interview series. articles.title: See Ya, California! Harry and Meghan Are Making a Surprising New Move—Here’s What’s Going On
articles.content:
记得梅根退出事件吗？确实，我们也记得！2020年1月，哈利和梅根退出王室时，他们大肆宣传离开英国，并在加州开始新生活。随之而来的戏剧性事件也同样引人注目。有时，似乎他们做什么都不会让我们感到惊讶了。但哈利和梅根证明我们错了。

在美国生活了六年多后，这对夫妇准备开始新的篇章。他们通过搬家来实现这一点。这一次，他们选择的家庭基地是个出人意料的地方——我们甚至怀疑你也没猜到。但搬家即将发生，而且据说迫在眉睫。就像孩子开学前那样。

那么，他们要去哪里，为什么？继续往下读，了解皇室动态。

《每日电讯报》和《人物》杂志报道，哈利、梅根和他们的孩子将在接下来的两周内跨大陆搬迁。目前还不清楚他们计划定居何处，但肯定不会是王室的豪华宫殿之一。

根据媒体报道，伦敦已被排除在外，他们可能会生活在英国乡村。科茨沃尔兹（Cotswolds）是一个可能的选项，距离首都不足两小时车程，以绿色山丘和石屋村庄闻名。这对夫妇的亲密朋友埃伦·德杰内瑞斯（Ellen DeGeneres）在此有一座别墅，大卫和维多利亚·贝克汉姆也住在这里，尽管哈利和梅根曾怀疑他们有泄露新闻给媒体的行为。

另一个选项似乎是诺桑普顿地区。位于科茨沃尔兹以北，靠近阿尔索普庄园（Althorp Estate），这是戴安娜王妃的成长地和葬身之地。哈利和梅根今年7月带着孩子们去此处参观过。

阿奇和丽丽贝特已在英国学校注册，准备在9月开始新生活。

他们确实改变了许多事情。

哈利和梅根退出皇室生活后，这对夫妇失去了作为交易一部分的纳税人资助的警方保护，哈利表示他在英国不再感到安全。他甚至起诉内政部和伦敦警察厅要求恢复保护，但败诉后多次单独前往伦敦和英国，没有带上妻子和孩子，原因是安全问题。他在BBC节目中说：“我看不到一个世界，现在我会带我的妻子和孩子回英国。”

尚不清楚今后如何管理安全问题。由于哈利和梅根仍然是非工作王室成员，他们仍不会获得纳税人资助的保护。英国首相安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）已称这些安排是“私人事务”。

哈利还长期批评英国小报和狗仔队，指责他们不仅让他母亲的生活变成噩梦，还导致1997年8月在巴黎去世。哈利担心历史会在梅根身上重演。2026年7月，王子在与《每日邮报》和《星期日邮报》的庭审中败诉，他指控对方使用非法手段收集他的信息。

当然，还有家庭矛盾。在回忆录《备用》和著名的奥普拉访谈中，哈利表示他感到查尔斯国王“让他失望”，并称王室从一开始就不喜欢梅根。梅根本人透露了一些不愉快的闭门谈话，内容涉及阿奇的肤色，并表示她曾经有严重的心理健康问题，甚至不想活下去。哈利还提到与威廉复杂的关系，称他的哥哥曾对他动手。这些披露没有得到王室的欢迎——王室信奉“从不抱怨，从不解释”的原则——也没有得到英国公众的支持。

根据皇室内部人士透露，哈利是此次搬家的主要推动力。丹·韦克福德（Dan Wakeford）是名人情报创始人、前《人物》杂志总编辑，他表示：“大家都认为梅根在两人的关系中说了算，但哈利实际上得到了他想要的一切。这正是哈利身边的人在4月描述的情况——一个怀念家庭、朋友、旧生活的人，一个愿意缩减规模以换取部分回归的人。”

在7月访问英国期间，查尔斯首次在四年后见到孙子阿奇和丽丽贝特。除了哈利一家与他及其他家人共度美好时光外，查尔斯还在两年前被诊断出患癌，目前仍在接受治疗，因此哈利可能希望更接近父亲。

最后，哈利和梅根在美国的商业投资并未如期发展。他们的网飞节目被取消，梅根的生活方式品牌“As ever”的合作也结束。这可能是一个新的开始，尽管他们将保留加州蒙特西托的住所和葡萄牙的度假屋。

暂时不会。根据报道，查尔斯在私下表示，萨塞克斯夫妇将保持私人身份，而不会成为工作王室成员，而威廉作为未来国王，也不可能提出皇室复职，考虑到他们之间持续的紧张关系。

那么这对夫妇将来会做什么？哈利可能会花更多时间在他的英国慈善机构，包括WellChild、Scotty's Little Soldiers和Invictus社区，而梅根则计划在新的家庭基地继续经营As ever。虽然有人认为这证明这对夫妇成功实现了最初向伊丽莎白二世女王提出的“半进半退”计划（独立生活同时代表王室），但王室似乎对这种安排没有兴趣。实际上，哈利和梅根最可能的做法是继续追求商业投资，但作为私人公民而非王室代表。

从技术上讲，他们可以，但我们认为不太可能。由于隐私原因，尚未公布阿奇和丽丽贝特在英国将入读哪所学校。凯特和威廉的孩子夏洛特和路易斯目前就读于伯克郡的兰布鲁克学校（Lambrook School），这是一所距离温莎家园10分钟车程的预科学校。乔治刚从兰布鲁克毕业，即将进入伊顿公学，这是一所附近的精英寄宿学校，主要面向13至18岁的男孩——威廉和哈利曾在这里度过青春期。

这仍有待观察。去年，哈利在BBC节目中证实了我们所知道的：与家人的关系紧张。但他也公开承认，他“希望和解”。所以这会是和解的开始吗？

英国媒体报道称，哈利和梅根通知查尔斯国王他们的搬家计划，而不是作为家庭共同作出决定。几周前他们访问海格罗夫时也没有提及计划，因此我们只能想象君主也和我们一样惊讶！考虑到查尔斯在过去四年中没有见过孙子，他可能会因为未来可能更多见到家人而感到高兴，尽管过去有许多戏剧性事件。

至于威廉，这些隔阂不会一夜之间修复。毕竟，两兄弟的关系一直很复杂。当哈利和梅根退出皇室，哈利公开谈论与哥哥的问题时，两人彻底决裂。皇室传记作家罗伯特·乔布森（Robert Jobson）在新闻爆出后告诉《Hello!》杂志：“我感到威廉对整件事有点震惊。浪子回头对威廉来说会很困难。哈利的搬家给威廉带来压力，迫使他采取更务实的态度。”

但他们是兄弟，家庭总有重新团聚的方式。而且，谁不希望戴安娜的两个儿子能有个美好的结局呢？
articles.summary:
Remember Megxit? Yep, we do too! When Harry and Meghan quit the royal family in January 2020, they made a BIG deal of leaving the U.K. and starting their new life in California. And all the drama that followed afterward made just as many headlines. Sometimes, it seemed like there really was nothing they could do that would still surprise us. But Harry and Meghan have proven us wrong.

After more than six years in the U.S., the pair is ready for a new chapter. And they’re doing that by moving. Again. Their new home base? It’s one that wasn’t on our bingo card—and we’re pretty sure it wasn’t on yours either. But the move is happening, and it’s apparently imminent. Like, before-the-kids-go-back-to-school imminent.

So where are they going, and why? Read on for the royal scoop.

Get Reader’s Digest’s Read Up newsletter for more royals, humor, cleaning, travel, tech and fun facts all week long.

Where are Harry and Meghan moving?

The Sussexes are moving to the last place anyone would expect: the U.K. Yes, you read that right. According to The Telegraph and People magazine, Harry, Meghan and their kids will move continents within the next two weeks. It’s not clear yet where they plan to settle, but it will definitely not be one of the royals’ fancy palaces.

According to media reports, London has been ruled out, and they’ll likely live in the British countryside. The Cotswolds, less than two hours from the capital and one of the country’s most beautiful regions (known for its green hills and picturesque stone villages), has been rumored as an option. The couple’s close friend Ellen DeGeneres has a mansion there, as do the Beckhams, whom they once counted as friends before Harry and Meghan reportedly suspected them of leaking stories to the press.

Another option seems to be the Northampton area. Just north of the Cotswolds and close to Althorp Estate, it’s where Princess Diana grew up and is now buried. Harry and Meghan took their kids there to visit during their recent July trip.

Archie and Lilibet are already enrolled in British schools, ready to start their new lives in September. (More on that below.)

Hold on—didn’t they have huge problems in the U.K.?

They did, on multiple fronts.

After Harry and Meghan stepped back from royal life, the couple lost the taxpayer-funded police security that came as part of the deal, and Harry said he no longer felt safe in the U.K. He even filed a lawsuit (which he lost) against the Home Office and the Metropolitan police to get the protection back, then made multiple trips to London and the U.K. without his wife and kids over security concerns. He told the BBC, “I can’t see a world in which I would bring my wife and children back to the U.K. at this point.”

It remains to be seen how the security will be managed moving forward. Since Harry and Meghan remain non-working royals, they still won’t receive taxpayer-funded protection. Britain’s prime minister, Andy Burnham, has already called the arrangements a “private matter.”

Harry has also been a long-term critic of the British tabloids and paparazzi, accusing them of not only turning his mother’s life into a nightmare but also causing her death in Paris in August 1997. Harry feared that history would repeat itself with Meghan. In July 2026, the prince lost a court case against the Daily Mail and Mail on Sunday, which he’d accused of using unlawful methods to gather information about him.

Then, of course, there was all the family drama. In his memoir, Spare, and a now-infamous Oprah interview, Harry said he felt “let down” by King Charles and claimed the royals had disliked Meghan from day one. Meghan herself revealed an unpleasant conversation behind closed doors about Archie’s skin color and said that she struggled so much with her mental health at one point that she no longer wanted to be alive. Harry also addressed his complicated relationship with William, claiming his brother had physically attacked him. These revelations didn’t go over well with the royal family—who religiously live by their “Never complain, never explain” rule—or the British public.

What prompted this move back to the U.K.?

Harry is reportedly the driving force behind this move, according to royal insiders. “Everyone presumes that Meghan calls the shots in their relationship, but Harry just got everything he wanted,” says royal expert Dan Wakeford, the founder of Celebrity Intelligence and former editor-in-chief of People. “This is the exact arrangement people close to Harry described in April—a man who missed his family, his friends, his old life and who’d be content to downsize if it meant getting some of that back.”

During the Sussexes’ visit to the U.K. in July, Charles got to see his grandchildren Archie and Lilibet for the first time in four years. And it wasn’t just that Harry and crew had fun with him and other family members: Charles is still undergoing cancer treatments two years after his initial diagnosis, so Harry might just want to be closer to his dad.

Last but not least, Harry’s and Meghan’s business ventures in the U.S. haven’t quite worked out as planned. Their Netflix show was axed, and the partnership with Meghan’s lifestyle brand, As ever, ended. This could be a fresh start for them, even though they will reportedly keep their home in Montecito, California, along with their vacation home in Portugal.

Does this mean they’ll become working royals again?

No. Or at least not for the time being. According to reports, Charles has made it clear behind closed doors that the Sussexes will remain private citizens rather than working royals, while William, as the future king, is equally unlikely to propose a royal comeback considering their ongoing tensions.

So what will the couple actually do? Harry will likely spend more time with his U.K.-based charities, including WellChild, Scotty’s Little Soldiers and the Invictus community, while Meghan plans to keep running As ever from the family’s new home base. While some say this is proof that the pair has successfully navigated the “half in, half out” plan they initially proposed to Queen Elizabeth II (living an independent life while still representing the royal family), the British side of the family seems to have no interest in the arrangement. In reality, Harry and Meghan will most likely continue to pursue business ventures, but will do so strictly as private citizens and not representatives of the royal family.

Will Archie and Lilibet be going to school with their cousins?

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by Meghan, Duchess of Sussex (@meghan)


Technically they could, but we believe it’s unlikely. For privacy reasons, it hasn’t been announced what school Archie and Lilibet will go to in the U.K. Kate’s and William’s kids Charlotte and Louis currently attend Lambrook School in Berkshire, a prep school about a 10-minute drive from their home in Windsor. And George, who just graduated from Lambrook, is about to start at Eton College, a nearby elite boarding school for boys aged 13 to 18—the same one William and Harry attended as teenagers.

What does this mean for Harry’s relationship with Charles, William and the rest of the family?

That remains to be seen. Last year, Harry confirmed on the BBC what we all knew: that the relationship with his family was frosty. But he also admitted openly that he “would love a reconciliation.” So could this be it?

British media outlets are reporting that Harry and Meghan informed King Charles about their move rather than made the decision together as a family. It also looks like there had been no mention of the plans when they visited him in Highgrove just a few weeks ago, so we can only imagine the monarch must have been as surprised as we are! Considering that Charles hadn’t seen his grandchildren for four years prior to the whirlwind visit, he will probably still be pleased that he might see more of his family in the future, despite all the drama in the past.

As for William, those fences won’t be mended overnight. After all, the brothers have always had a complicated relationship. And they fully fell out when Harry and Meghan quit The Firm and Harry publicly aired his issues with his big brother. As royal biographer Robert Jobson told Hello! magazine after the news dropped, “I feel that William must be slightly aghast by the whole thing. The prodigal son coming back will be difficult for him. Harry’s move puts pressure on him to act in a more pragmatic way.”

But they are brothers, and family has a way of coming back together over time. And hey, who wouldn’t love a happy ending for Diana’s boys?

articles.title: This Is the Most Popular M&M’s Flavor in Each State—Did Your Favorite Take the Top Spot Where You Live?
articles.content:
我小时候，M&M's只分为两种口味：坚果风味和普通风味。如果你喜欢坚果，就选糖衣花生；如果不喜欢坚果，或者对坚果过敏，又或者是个喜欢坚果但不喜欢它们混在食物里的奇怪孩子（好吧，对当时的我来说确实是这样），那么就只能吃普通M&M's了。

如今，M&M's的口味选择远不止这两种。现有超过10种口味的M&M's，而且它们仍然不会融化在手上。但哪一种口味在你所在的州最受欢迎呢？

保险巨头Coventry Direct对此也感到好奇，并公布了相关调查结果。你是坚持原汁原味的M&M's，还是更喜欢新奇的口味？接下来，我将带你了解每个州最受欢迎的M&M's口味，看看你的最爱是否榜上有名。

就像许多人目前的个人偏好一样，我们最喜欢的M&M's口味是通过搜索记录确定的。虽然原因不明，但Coventry Direct决定查看2025年5月至2026年5月期间的Google Trends数据，了解美国人最常搜索的M&M's口味。

当你看到这些选择时，你可能会怀疑某些小众口味，比如咖啡焦糖味，真的能成为某个州最受欢迎的M&M's吗？比起花生酱M&M's——被誉为所有M&M's中的王者？（随时准备为这点争论。）

但考虑到这些数据基于互联网搜索而非实际购买量，就不难理解为何咖啡馆之都俄勒冈州的居民对咖啡焦糖味M&M's充满好奇。这并不奇怪。

50个州和哥伦比亚特区在搜索结果上展现了惊人的多样性，从经典的普通M&M's到绝对不讨喜的白巧克力M&M's，甚至还有新出的口味让我都不知道它们属于M&M's。（巧克力布朗尼？我竟然错过了这个！）

以下是各州搜索量最多的M&M's口味：

焦糖M&M's以12个州的搜索量位居榜首，紧随其后的是原始彩色糖衣M&M's，占据11个州的搜索量。

焦糖M&M's于2017年5月上市，经过多年的研发才解决了生产难题。（将软焦糖包裹在硬糖衣中并不容易，这也是为什么焦糖通常以塑料包装的方块形式出售。）显然，消费者对这一结果感到满意。

观察地图，首先引人注目的是西北山区的投票集团，他们钟爱普通M&M's。蒙大拿州、怀俄明州、爱达荷州和相邻的北达科他州在这一口味上占主导地位。再加上阿拉斯加州和新墨西哥州，普通M&M's在密西西比河以西的州中获得了超过一半的支持。

大赢家焦糖M&M's的分布则更为分散。华盛顿州和科罗拉多州代表西部地区，然后是一片从科罗拉多州到俄亥俄州，从密西西比州到明尼苏达州的焦糖M&M's爱好者区域。此外，纽约州和南卡罗来纳州也喜爱焦糖M&M's。

花生M&M's在6个州中获胜，其中4个州位于南部：德克萨斯州、阿肯色州、西弗吉尼亚州和佐治亚州，这些州不仅喜爱花生，还种植花生。剩下的两个州是内华达州和一个新英格兰州——康涅迪格州。

我惊讶于竟然有人吃白巧克力M&M's，但路易斯安那州的人们热爱它。夏威夷州则有一匹黑马，即超大花生酱M&M's，这是更大的花生酱M&M's版本。

而新罕布什尔州则走向了饮食极端，他们狂热地搜索花生酱肉桂卷M&M's，这是一种临时推出的产品，将两种我从未想过能搭配在一起的风味结合了。有人在现实中见过这些吗？

但最大的惊喜要数Crispy M&M's，尽管它在过去25年中断断续续地推出，但仍然赢得了3个州的青睐。这种轻脆的糖果最初于1999年推出，2005年停产，2015年重新上市，2022年又停产。目前，你可以从在线零售商那里购买，但最好多买一些，因为它们可能不会长久存在。

原文链接：Reader's Digest
articles.summary:
When I was growing up, we had two flavors of M&M’s. If you liked nuts, you grabbed the Peanut M&M’s at the movies or on Halloween when given the choice by silly parents who left the basket out. If you didn’t like peanuts, were allergic or were just a strange kid who liked nuts but didn’t like them *in* things (hey, it made sense to me), well, you got plain M&M’s.

Now, not to be all “uphill both ways” about my limited choices as a youngster, but people today have it much better, at least when it comes to M&M’s. There are now more than 10 current varieties of the popular treat, and they all melt in your mouth, not in your hands. But which one rules the candy aisle where you live?

Coventry Direct, the insurance giant, wondered the same thing—and we have the results coming up. Are you an M&M’s purist, or do you prefer a quirkier, newer variety? Ahead, I’ll take you through the most popular M&M’s flavor in every state. Read on to see if your favorite made the cut where you live.

Get Reader’s Digest’s Read Up newsletter for more food news, cleaning, humor, travel, tech and fun facts all week long.

How did the report determine the most popular M&M’s in the country?

Like so many personal preferences these days, our favorite M&M’s were determined by our search history. We’re not entirely sure why, but Coventry Direct decided to check Google Trends data between May 2025 and May 2026 to learn which varieties of M&M’s Americans were seeking out most.

Once you see some of these choices, you may be a little skeptical that, for example, a niche flavor like Caramel Cold Brew could really be the most popular M&M’s across an entire state. I mean, better than Peanut Butter, the greatest M&M’s of all time? (Ready to fight over this one.)

But it makes sense when you remember that these faves are based on internet searches, not actual purchases. So is it really all that surprising that residents of Oregon, the coffeehouse capital of the world, were curious about cold-brew-flavored M&M’s? I think not.

What is the most popular M&M’s flavor in each state?

The 50 states and District of Columbia demonstrated a surprising amount of variation in their search results, from old favorites like plain M&M’s, absolutely-nots like White Chocolate, and some so new I had no idea they were even M&M’s. (Fudge Brownie? I missed that one.)

Here are the top-searched M&M’s flavors broken out by state.

  • Alabama: Dark Chocolate
  • Alaska: Original
  • Arizona: Dark Chocolate Peanut
  • Arkansas: Peanut
  • California: Dark Chocolate
  • Colorado: Caramel
  • Connecticut: Peanut
  • Delaware: Original
  • Florida: Fudge Brownie
  • Georgia: Peanut
  • Hawaii: Mega Peanut Butter
  • Idaho: Original
  • Illinois: Fudge Brownie
  • Indiana: Caramel
  • Iowa: Peanut Butter
  • Kansas: Peanut Butter
  • Kentucky: Crispy
  • Louisiana: White Chocolate
  • Maine: Original
  • Maryland: Caramel
  • Massachusetts: Dark Chocolate Peanut
  • Michigan: Dark Chocolate
  • Minnesota: Caramel
  • Mississippi: Caramel
  • Missouri: Caramel
  • Montana: Original
  • Nebraska: Crispy
  • Nevada: Peanut
  • New Hampshire: Peanut Butter Cinnamon Roll
  • New Jersey: Dark Chocolate
  • New Mexico: Original
  • New York: Caramel
  • North Carolina: Fudge Brownie
  • North Dakota: Original
  • Ohio: Caramel
  • Oklahoma: Caramel
  • Oregon: Caramel Cold Brew
  • Pennsylvania: Fudge Brownie
  • Rhode Island: Original
  • South Carolina: Caramel
  • South Dakota: Pretzel
  • Tennessee: Caramel
  • Texas: Peanut
  • Utah: Peanut Butter
  • Vermont: Original
  • Virginia: Dark Chocolate Peanut
  • Washington: Caramel
  • Washington, D.C.: Original
  • West Virginia: Peanut
  • Wisconsin: Crispy
  • Wyoming: Original

Which flavor earned the No. 1 spot in the most states?

Caramel M&M’s took home the prize, with 12 states searching for the young upstart more than any other flavor. It was a tight race between Caramel and the OG colorful candy, plain M&M’s, which came in second, with 11 states.

Caramel M&M’s debuted in May 2017 after years of work to get production difficulties hammered out. (It’s hard to get a soft caramel inside a hard candy shell, which is why caramels are usually sold in plastic-wrapped squares.) Clearly, consumers are happy with the result.

How did this break down regionally?

Looking at the map of states, the first voting bloc you notice is the northern Mountain West, which loves plain M&M’s. Montana, Wyoming, Idaho and the adjacent North Dakota dominate the map for original M&M’s. Add in Alaska and New Mexico, and plain M&M’s get more than half of their support from states west of the Mississippi.

The big winner, Caramel M&M’s, has a more scattered dispersal. Washington and Colorado rep the flavor out West, and then there’s a swath of Caramel M&M’s lovers across the central U.S. from Colorado to Ohio and from Mississippi to Minnesota. New Yorkers also love Caramel M&M’s, as do South Carolinians.

Peanut M&M’s won six states, including four in the South: Texas, Arkansas, West Virginia and Georgia, where peanuts are popular (and grown). Rounding out the six are Nevada and one lone New England state, Connecticut.

Were there any big surprises?

I was surprised anyone actually eats White Chocolate M&M’s, but Louisiana loves them. Or loves searching for them. Hawaii also had a dark-horse No. 1, Mega Peanut Butter M&M’s, which are just larger versions of the (already big) Peanut Butter M&M’s.

Then there’s New Hampshire. The Live Free or Die state went way out on a culinary limb and searched ravenously for Peanut Butter Cinnamon Roll M&M’s, a temporary offering that captures two flavors I had no idea went together. Has anyone seen these in the wild?

But the biggest surprise goes to Crispy M&M’s, which won three states despite being available on an on-again-off-again basis for the last 25 years. The light and crunchy confection launched in 1999 before being discontinued in 2005, reintroduced in 2015 and discontinued again in 2022. As of right now, you can buy them from online retailers, but you’d better stock up, because they might not last.
